frontmatter.title: Data Visualization: D3.js vs Chart.js
frontmatter.subheading: A comparison of two powerful data visualization libraries
frontmatter.excerpt: Data visualization is a powerful tool that enables us to understand complex information quickly and easily. This article compares D3.js and Chart.js, explaining their strengths, weaknesses, real-world use cases, and when each library actually makes sense.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
